observations: Experiment: EXP-RUNTIME-35530588298, Lane: runtime, Architecture: pure in-memory decompression comparison (no HTTP/proxies) — streaming decompressor APIs (brotli.Decompressor.process + gzip.GzipFile.read) vs full-body decompression (brotli.decompress + gzip.decompress)

Streaming brotli decompression: brotli.Decompressor().process(chunk) fed CHUNK_SIZE chunks produces output as available; no flush()/finish() method exists on brotli 1.2.0 Decompressor — process() is the sole API for incremental decompression
Streaming gzip decompression: gzip.GzipFile(io.BytesIO(compressed)).read(CHUNK_SIZE) loops produce byte-identical output to gzip.decompress()

Multi-layer streaming decompression: outer layer via streaming API feeds inner compressed bytes to inner layer streaming API — sequential requirement, not parallel. GZIP-THEN-BROTLI: brotli streaming decompresses outer, then gzip streaming decompresses inner. BROTLI-THEN-GZIP: gzip streaming decompresses outer, then brotli streaming decompresses inner.
Pre-flight Shannon entropy: JSON mean 5.49 min 5.44 max 5.57; HTML mean 4.66 min 4.65 max 4.67; BINARY mean 7.69 min 7.67 max 7.70 — all >=3.5 bits/byte threshold

Main multi-layer cells: 24 cells (2 sizes x 3 types x 2 encodings x 2 chunk sizes) x 20 obs = 480 streaming + 480 full-body = 960 decompression comparisons; all streaming_hash == fullbody_hash (480/480) byte-identical; all streaming_hash == expected_hash (480/480) correct; 0 decompression errors; 0 silent fallbacks

Regression cells: 12 cells (3 types x 2 single-layer modes x 2 chunk sizes) x 20 = 240 streaming + 240 full-body; all streaming_correct 240/240, fullbody_correct 240/240, streaming_equals_fullbody 240/240
Identity cells: 6 cells (3 types x 2 sizes) x 20 = 120 obs; all 120/120 correct
Within-state determinism: all 24 multi-layer + 12 regression cells show decompressed_hash all_same=true for all 4 states across 5 reps in both streaming and full-body paths (unique_count==1)

Compressed sizes: JSON 10KB mean 4331B / 100KB 36169B; HTML 10KB 2849B / 100KB 23602B; BINARY 10KB 9903B / 100KB 98672B — all 3/3 types meet >=2000 at 10KB and >=5000 at 100KB; overall range 2612-98730 bytes confirms non-degenerate high-entropy payloads
Chunk size independence: correctness holds at both realistic CDN chunk size 8192 (Cloudflare default ~8KB) and stress size 32 (maximizes chunk count and block boundary crossings)

Total correctness: streaming multi-layer 480/480 (100%), full-body multi-layer 480/480 (100%), regression 240/240 (100%), identity 120/120 (100%); aggregate 840/840 streaming decompression observations correct
validity_notes: V1_BROTLI_STREAMING_API: brotli 1.2.0 Decompressor has only process(), can_accept_more_data(), is_finished() methods — no flush() or finish(). process() returns decompressed output as available and signals completion via is_finished(). The initial run encountered a flush() AttributeError that was silently caught, producing incorrect results; corrected by removing flush() call. This is a valid measurement after the correction.

V2_MULTI_LAYER_SEQUENTIAL: multi-layer streaming decompression requires sequential unwrapping — outer streaming decompressor must complete before inner streaming decompressor begins. This is architecturally correct: real CDN/proxy pipelines process Content-Encoding layers sequentially.

V3_PURE_IN_MEMORY: experiment is entirely in-process (no HTTP servers, no proxies, no network). This eliminates network confounds but means CDN-specific behaviors (Accept-Encoding negotiation, Vary/cache, geographic latency, TCP segmentation) are not tested. Claim ceiling bounded to in-process decompressor API correctness.

V4_PYTHON_STDLIB_GZIP: gzip streaming uses Python 3.12 stdlib gzip.GzipFile. Different Python versions or gzip library implementations may have different streaming behavior, but the stdlib API is stable.
V5_CHUNK_SIZE_EQUALITY: streaming decompressor receives compressed data in CHUNK_SIZE chunks matching the frozen spec (8192 and 32). No mixed-size matrix tested.
V6_SAME_PROCESS_ORACLE: correctness oracle is in-process generate_*_body(state, target_size) SHA256; bounded to same interpreter session determinism.
V7_BINARY_HASHSEED: BINARY body header contains struct.pack(hash(state)) which is PYTHONHASHSEED-dependent; determinism holds within single process — confirmed all_same=true across reps.
V8_MULTI_LAYER_DEPTH_2: only two-layer stacked encodings tested (GZIP-THEN-BROTLI, BROTLI-THEN-GZIP); depths 3-5 untested but spec max_depth=5 is used in iterative decompressor.
